---
title: "Bedroom"
output:
  html_document:
    df_print: paged
---



```{r}
housing <- read.csv("housing.csv")
```

```{r}
housing$bedrooms <- factor(
  housing$n.rooms,
  levels = 0:5,
  labels = c("0 bedrooms", "1 bedroom", "2 bedrooms",
             "3 bedrooms", "4 bedrooms", "5+ bedrooms")
)

cols <- c("#4e79a7", "#f28e2b", "#59a14f", "#e15759", "#76b7b2", "#b07aa1")

boxplot(
  income ~ bedrooms,
  data    = housing,
  col     = adjustcolor(cols, alpha.f = 0.85),
  border  = "grey30",
  xlab    = "Number of Bedrooms",
  ylab    = "Household Income (£)",
  main    = "Household Income by Number of Bedrooms\nUK Housing Survey 2021/22",
  yaxt    = "n",   # custom y-axis below
  outline = TRUE
)

axis(2, at = axTicks(2),
     labels = paste0("£", formatC(axTicks(2), format = "d", big.mark = ",")))

n_labels <- table(housing$bedrooms)
mtext(paste0("n=", n_labels), side = 1, line = 2.5,
      at = seq_along(levels(housing$bedrooms)), cex = 0.75, col = "grey40")

abline(h = axTicks(2), lty = 2, col = "grey80")

```
